title: Thin Accretion Disks around Rotating Charged Black Holes in an Effective Higher-Curvature Spacetime
summary: We investigate the structure and emission properties of a thin accretion disk around a rotating charged black hole described by an effective higher-curvature-inspired spacetime, constructed as a phenomenological deformation of the Kerr Newman geometry. In this framework, the deformation is introduced through a modification of the metric function $Δ$ by an effective Gauss-Bonnet-like parameter $α$, such that the spacetime reduces to the standard Kerr Newman solution in the limit $α\to 0$.
